title: strophanthus robustus
intro: Strophanthus robustus, commonly known as the Cape or Natal arrowroot, is a plant species belonging to the family Apocynaceae. The health benefits of Strophanthus robustus include its potential to treat various cardiovascular conditions, such as hypertension and heart failure, due to its ability to lower blood pressure and improve cardiac function. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its cardiac glycoside and bufadienolide compounds, which exhibit inotropic and chronotropic effects, thereby increasing the contractility of the heart muscle and slowing its rate of contraction. The bioactive constituents of Strophanthus robustus include strophanthin, a cardiac glycoside, and bufadienolides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
